mechanism: Armodafinil is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce verapamil plasma concentrations, potentially decreasing its cardiovascular efficacy; verapamil may also increase armodafinil levels via CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and arrhythmias; consider verapamil dose adjustment if efficacy decreases; assess for armodafinil-related side effects.
